verdict.rationale: Buzz is itself a WebSocket Nostr relay. Third-party clients and bots connect directly over NIP-29 with NIP-42 auth, using their own keypair identities, which amounts to a documented gateway connection. The first-party buzz-acp harness shows a bot that listens for @mentions on the relay in real time and replies. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event subscription and filtering for bots (which event kinds stream, and reconnect/backfill semantics), a dedicated bot-events guide beyond 'API parity comes from the protocol', and independent hands-on corroboration.
